decks.notes: The deck focuses on using lands as a resource to control the game, with cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, and Exploration helping to ramp up and generate value. Urza's Saga serves as a key engine for finding key pieces like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful combo. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Mox Diamond, Pithing Needle, and Boseiju, Who Endures to control the opponent's plays. Overall, the main goal is to establish a strong land base and control the game until the win condition is achieved.

decks.player: Ernesto Filipe Teixeira Fernandes Da Silva
decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly milling out the entire library and winning the game with Thassa's Oracle or Undercity Informer triggering when there are no cards left to draw. It utilizes a combination of fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and rituals, along with creature cards that allow for explosive plays such as Balustrade Spy and Boggart Trawler. The deck also includes protection like Pact of Negation and disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to ensure the combo can go off without interruption.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana and card advantage using the Elf tribe, with cards like Heritage Druid, Nettle Sentinel, and Birchlore Rangers. This allows the player to cast powerful spells like Natural Order to search for and put a game-ending creature like Craterhoof Behemoth into play. Additionally, cards like Glimpse of Nature and Once Upon a Time help to dig for key pieces, while Allosaurus Shepherd protects against counterspells. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and finish the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then bring them back into play using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This allows the player to cheat powerful creatures into play early in the game, overwhelming their opponent with threats that are difficult to deal with. The deck includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as card draw and selection to find the pieces needed to execute the strategy efficiently. The mana base is built around fetching dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on using Cephalid Illusionist along with Nomads en-Kor to mill cards from the library and combo off with Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for the win. The deck also utilizes cards like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card draw and protection. With a mix of control and combo pieces like Force of Will and Brainstorm, the deck aims to execute its win condition efficiently while also having some disruption to stop opponent's game plan. The land base includes Urza's Saga for additional value and fetching capabilities.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Grim Monolith and Chrome Mox to cast high-cost cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Paradox Engine. Coveted Jewel is a key card that can generate a lot of mana and card advantage. The deck also includes various ways to search for or copy important artifacts, and control elements like Force of Will to protect your combo pieces. Show and Tell can also be used to cheat out powerful cards early in the game.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and control elements. It utilizes powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to protect its own game plan while also putting pressure on the opponent with cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Flame of Anor. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon to hinder the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and control the pace of the game to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for quick, explosive plays. The deck utilizes a mix of control elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces and disrupt opponents, while also including cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find key cards. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game and secure a victory before they can mount a defense.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the Dark Depths combo with Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. It utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for the combo pieces efficiently. The deck also has disruption with cards like Gaddock Teeg, Swords to Plowshares, and Prismatic Ending to control the game while setting up the combo. Additionally, cards like Sylvan Library and Endurance provide card advantage and protection against enemy interaction. The strategy is to quickly assemble the combo and win the game through a powerful, hard-to-answer threat.

The primary objective of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt the opponent's hand and play, along with powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and secure a quick victory. The deck also has strong removal options like Fatal Push and Nihil Spellbomb to deal with opposing threats, making it a well-rounded and versatile aggro-tempo deck in Legacy format.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while quickly deploying aggressive creatures such as Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Chrome Mox and Urza's Saga to generate mana and create further pressure. Additionally, cards like Sundering Eruption and Fury provide removal options for problematic opposing threats. Overall, this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and seize control of the game through a combination of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts such as Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator to create an unstoppable combo engine. By consistently generating mana with cards like Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, the deck can cast powerful spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command to control the board. Additionally, the inclusion of Urza's Saga and Urza's Tower provide additional resources and stability to the deck. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through a strong and resilient board presence.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of artifacts to generate mana and control the board. By utilizing cards like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator, the deck can churn through its library to find key pieces like Basalt Monolith and Paradox Engine. The goal is to establish a lock on the game using cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Mycosynth Lattice, while also using cards like Ugin, the Eye of the Storms and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain to further control the battlefield. Once the combo is assembled, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with its powerful artifacts.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to cheat them into play. It also has disruption in the form of Counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, as well as hand disruption with Thoughtseize. The goal is to bring out big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent and win through a fast and efficient combo strategy. The deck also has versatile answers like Brazen Borrower and Cling to Dust to deal with opposing threats.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Entomb and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to set up the graveyard with key creatures. The deck includes a mix of disruption spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The key strategy is to cheat out big threats early on and overwhelm the opponent before they can react. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent strategy.
